Worflow Why Automation Testing
Automation Testing is the process of
using tools, scripts, and software to
perform test cases by repeating pre-
defined actions. Test Automation focuses
on replacing manual human activity with
systems or devices.

slides.title: Why Automation Testing?
slides.body:
Private and Confidential
© Copyright Kineton, 2022- www.kineton.it
It’s possible to execute a huge number
of tests in just 24 hours.
Efficient
Automation allows most of the tests
already written to be used in new
projects as well.
Versatile
Automation allows testing even at night.
Flexible
The same tests are performed quickly
whenever the new software is released.
Repeatable
Automation increases the speed of test
execution. It can perform testing much
faster than a human can.
Fast
Automation testing improves accuracy
and reduces human-generated error.
Reliable

slides.title: ECU -TEST
slides.body:
Private and Confidential
© Copyright Kineton, 2022- www.kineton.it
Main features
- Allows to automate the control of the whole test
environment
- Supports a broad range of test tools
- Facilitate each validation step
- Is based on very user-friendly commands and
interfaces
- Does not require programming skills
- Allows to use shared library
ECU-TEST
ECU-TEST is a software tool developed by TraceTronic
for test and validation of embedded systems and used as
standard tool in the development of automotive ECUs.
